description: Native ArcGIS item 3051f7927eb241a3a0c3a09a33511ad9 is a map service for research on oil and gas pipelines alongside the railway network. Its source explicitly discusses transport alternatives, routing and energy risk in the context of Line 5. Six separately catalogued members are exact layers of this same service: pipelines, First Nation points/boundaries/buffers, Nation extent and a Great Lakes basin layer. Two related web-map/application items share the named pipeline–rail subject; they are retained as distinct interfaces without claiming a proven identical configuration. The application metadata discusses alternative rail and tanker capacity, but these are source-reported scenario assertions, not verified present capacity. Native terms exclude navigation, engineering design and legal land determination. No topology, flow data, features or app configuration was retrieved. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: Anishinabek Nation Lands and Resources Department; source-specific creators retained. Licence: Native ArcGIS source-specific terms: information-sharing or educational/analytical use where stated; standard licence unstated. Costs and current file access are unverified. Access metadata says public; isopen is false. No linked dataset, workbook, document, archive or model/code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown. Related source components retain their own identities.
